contexts.text: The breadth (of the ark, ) = the truth of (remains).

That breadth = truth, Illustrated. AC 3434. AC 3901:8. AC 4482, Illustrated. AC 4482, Explained. AC 5201:6. AC 6534:6. AC 8898:end. AC 9028. AC 9487:3. AC 9488:end. AC 9530. AC 9601. AC 9618. AC 9637. AC 9716. AC 9755. AC 9758. AC 9862. AC 10179. DLW 71:end. AE 355:35. AE 435:8. AE 627:4. AE 629:4. AE 675:15.
Fullness of breadth () = full of falsities.
To a land good and broad () = to Heaven, where there are the good of charity and the truth of faith.
Breadth means from south to north, and by the south and the north is signified truth from one boundary to the other... HH 197:3, Illustrated. AR 906.
Under Degree, see these references. DLW 184. DLW 185.
Breadth = truth and its extension. References.
The breadth of the earth () = the truth of the Church. AR 861:2, Explained, Illustrated.
The breadth (of the holy city) = the truth of the Church.
Breadth of spaces () = truths from good in multitude and extension.
A broad meadow () = the Word, through which there is Divine influx and spiritual nourishment; broad is said from the extension and multiplication of truth. AC 6049:end.
Breadth = the truth of doctrine from the Word; wherefore to cause my feet to stand in breadth () = to cause to live according to Divine truths.
